items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: that's how I took the lesson from Man Manetta

ctx.x: Yeah. You were on that picture, isn't there a music stand on that picture?

Yeah, well yeah, that's how I took the lesson from Man Manetta. Oh. Yeah, you see. Did you start playing music? You mean we had music? Yeah. Did you play music? Or just head numbers? Yeah. We weren't using the music then. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No.
